# Mainbrella

> Cloud computers for AI agents.

Mainbrella provides isolated Linux containers with SSH and browser terminal access. Sign in and choose a monthly plan to use containers.

Plans have fixed monthly prices and no compute usage charges: Builder $5/month, Pro $180/month, and Scale $999/month. All plans offer Lite, Small, Medium, Large, and XL sizes and include internet access. Monthly compute-unit hours: Builder 250, Pro 9,000, Scale 50,000. Concurrent compute units: 28 / 128 / 640, alongside container ceilings.

Builder allows 5 concurrent containers, 1,000 starts per month, sessions up to 1 hour, and a 10-minute idle timeout. Pro allows 100 concurrent containers, 10,000 starts per month, sessions up to 24 hours, and a 30-minute idle timeout. Scale allows 500 concurrent containers, 100,000 starts per month, sessions up to 72 hours, and a 60-minute idle timeout.

Historical prototype startup benchmarks have incomplete original metadata and raw samples; they are not rolling operational metrics or service guarantees: 30/30 create tests succeeded at P50 381 ms and P95 528 ms; 100/100 concurrent starts succeeded at P95 680 ms.

Sizes and units/hour: lite 1 (1/16 vCPU, 256 MiB, 2 GB disk); small 6 (0.5 vCPU, 4 GiB, 8 GB); medium 10 (1 vCPU, 6 GiB, 12 GB); large 16 (2 vCPU, 8 GiB, 16 GB); xl 28 (4 vCPU, 12 GiB, 20 GB). POST /containers accepts size with catalogId or imageId; default lite. Runtime is reserved before start; unused runtime is released on confirmed stop. Sessions stop at their budget deadline or UTC month boundary. No automatic overages or top-ups.

Protected previews are implemented locally but await live qualification. Check previews.supported in /capabilities before issuance. Start your HTTP server first; POST /containers/previews with exact id/createdAt and port returns a one-time bearer URL. GET lists metadata only; DELETE with previewId revokes. Local JS/Python SDKs provide sandbox.previews.create/list/revoke. See https://mainbrella.com/docs/containers/#previews for limits and safe reconciliation.
